config.conventions: Precision tiers and calibration thresholds are engineering conventions, not anatomical accuracy guarantees. Native segment rotations require anatomical calibration before clinical angles are interpreted.

previous_version.policy: development only; old final holdout stays spent

arm_fit.scope: Engineering representation and source-fidelity settings; expanded shoulder coordinate range is not a validated muscle operating range. Other formats retain K1 fitting.
arm_fit.initialization: first observed frame in original model shoulder range, then expanded-range IK; model defaults preserved
arm_fit.selection: compare joint-centre original/expanded ranges and original-range registered markers on final filtered source geometry; maximize angle-and-position valid share, then minimize arm joint RMSE

selection.scope: eight known failure windows plus eight preselected typical development windows; no new holdout
selection.policy: same coordinate ranges; CLoSD retains baseline because temporal error increases; other seven use two-pass interior rescue
selection.default_compatibility: explicit K3.1 only; K2 and K3 configurations retained

scope: all fixed development windows; same raw and bone-normalized reference; no new holdout
